meta.title: WeSync — Lightweight Hub for Small-Group Collaboration
meta.description: Task assignment, schedule sync, and member profiles for groups, travel groups, clubs, and other tight-knit teams. Lightweight and clear — no need for everyone to download the app.

hero.titleLine2: without relying on chaotic group chats
hero.subtitle: Tasks, schedules, assignments, and member profiles — for groups, travel groups, clubs, and more. Lightweight and clear, with no need for everyone to install the app.

useCases.sectionSubtitle: Any tight-knit circle of 3–20 people who trust each other and need to divide work and schedule events can use WeSync to stay organized.

family.title: Group
family.pain: School pickups, groceries, and medication reminders get lost in group chats.
family.solution: The organizer manages profiles and tasks — everyone knows who is responsible, and the whole group schedule is visible at a glance.

travel.title: Travel Group
travel.pain: Bookings, meeting times, IDs, and luggage details scroll past in the chat.
travel.solution: Trips go on the calendar with clear "who handles what" assignments — not everyone needs the app.

club.title: Club / Class Committee
club.pain: Event prep involves many tasks, uneven participation, and hard-to-track progress.
club.solution: Separate shared to-dos from personal tasks so preparation roles are crystal clear.

roommates.title: Roommates
roommates.pain: Utilities, cleaning rotations, and shared shopping rely on verbal agreements that are easily forgotten.
roommates.solution: Recurring tasks with reminders — every roommate assignment is recorded with a clear owner.

startup.title: Startup Team
startup.pain: You don't want enterprise tools, but you still need lightweight task and schedule coordination.
startup.solution: Manage progress from the web console, check in on mobile — just the right size for a small team.

features.sectionSubtitle: Uneven participation? That's where we started designing the product.

profile.title: No-Download Member Profiles
profile.description: No need to force every member to install the app. Organizers can create profiles for people who don't use the app — grandparents, children, temporary travel companions, or external collaborators. One person can manage the whole circle's schedule and to-dos, removing participation barriers entirely.

tasks.title: Dedicated Task Flow
tasks.description: Clearly separate shared to-dos from personal tasks. Book hotels, bring documents, prepare materials, rotate shifts — every item has an owner and trackable progress.

privacy.title: Enterprise-Grade Privacy
privacy.description: Deep integration with Apple native sign-in. Built on modern cloud-native architecture with end-to-end encryption for your circle's data.

sync.title: Seamless Multi-Device Console
sync.description: Smooth on mobile, plus a full web console. Plan trips, organize events, or track team progress from your desktop — everything stays in sync across platforms.
